verses.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.pt: Melhor é o pobre que anda na sua integridade, do que aquele que é perverso de lábios e tolo.
verses.en_web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
verses.en_bbe: Better is the poor man whose ways are upright, than the man of wealth whose ways are twisted.

verses.en: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
verses.pt: Não é bom agir sem refletir; e o que se apressa com seus pés erra o caminho.
verses.en_web: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge; nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
verses.en_bbe: Further, without knowledge desire is not good; and he who is over-quick in acting goes out of the right way.

verses.en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
verses.pt: A estultícia do homem perverte o seu caminho, e o seu coração se irrita contra o Senhor.
verses.en_web: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: By his foolish behaviour a man's ways are turned upside down, and his heart is bitter against the Lord.

verses.en: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
verses.pt: As riquezas granjeiam muitos amigos; mas do pobre o seu próprio amigo se separa.
verses.en_web: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
verses.en_bbe: Wealth makes a great number of friends; but the poor man is parted from his friend.

verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
verses.pt: A testemunha falsa não ficará impune; e o que profere mentiras não escapará.
verses.en_web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
verses.en_bbe: A false witness will not go without punishment, and the breather out of deceit will not go free.

verses.en: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
verses.pt: Muitos procurarão o favor do liberal; e cada um é amigo daquele que dá presentes.
verses.en_web: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
verses.en_bbe: Great numbers will make attempts to get the approval of a ruler: and every man is the special friend of him who has something to give.

verses.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
verses.pt: Todos os irmãos do pobre o aborrecem; quanto mais se afastam dele os seus amigos! persegue-os com súplicas, mas eles já se foram.
verses.en_web: All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
verses.en_bbe: All the brothers of the poor man are against him: how much more do his friends go far from him! ...

verses.en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
verses.pt: O que adquire a sabedoria é amigo de si mesmo; o que guarda o entendimento prosperará.
verses.en_web: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
verses.en_bbe: He who gets wisdom has love for his soul: he who keeps good sense will get what is truly good.

verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
verses.pt: A testemunha falsa não ficará impune, e o que profere mentiras perecerá.
verses.en_web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
verses.en_bbe: A false witness will not go without punishment, and the breather out of deceit will be cut off.

verses.en: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.pt: Ao tolo não convém o luxo; quanto menos ao servo dominar os príncipes!
verses.en_web: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.en_bbe: Material comfort is not good for the foolish; much less for a servant to be put over rulers.

verses.en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.pt: A discrição do homem fá-lo tardio em irar-se; e sua glória está em esquecer ofensas.
verses.en_web: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
verses.en_bbe: A man's good sense makes him slow to wrath, and the overlooking of wrongdoing is his glory.

verses.en: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
verses.pt: A ira do rei é como o bramido o leão; mas o seu favor é como o orvalho sobre a erva.
verses.en_web: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
verses.en_bbe: The king's wrath is like the loud cry of a lion, but his approval is like dew on the grass.

verses.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.pt: O filho insensato é a calamidade do pai; e as rixas da mulher são uma goteira contínua.
verses.en_web: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
verses.en_bbe: A foolish son is the destruction of his father; and the bitter arguments of a wife are like drops of rain falling without end.

verses.en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
verses.pt: Casa e riquezas são herdadas dos pais; mas a mulher prudente vem do Senhor.
verses.en_web: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: House and wealth are a heritage from fathers, but a wife with good sense is from the Lord.

verses.en: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.pt: A preguiça faz cair em profundo sono; e o ocioso padecerá fome.
verses.en_web: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.en_bbe: Hate of work sends deep sleep on a man: and he who has no industry will go without food.

verses.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
verses.pt: Quem guarda o mandamento guarda a sua alma; mas aquele que não faz caso dos seus caminhos morrerá.
verses.en_web: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps the law keeps his soul; but death will be the fate of him who takes no note of the word.

verses.en: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
verses.pt: O que se compadece do pobre empresta ao Senhor, que lhe retribuirá o seu benefício.
verses.en_web: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
verses.en_bbe: He who has pity on the poor gives to the Lord, and the Lord will give him his reward.

verses.en: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
verses.pt: Corrige a teu filho enquanto há esperança; mas não te incites a destruí-lo.
verses.en_web: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
verses.en_bbe: Give your son training while there is hope; let not your heart be purposing his death.

verses.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
verses.pt: Homem de grande ira tem de sofrer o castigo; porque se o livrares, terás de o fazer de novo.
verses.en_web: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
verses.en_bbe: A man of great wrath will have to take his punishment: for if you get him out of trouble you will have to do it again.

verses.en: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.pt: Ouve o conselho, e recebe a correção, para que sejas sábio nos teus últimos dias.
verses.en_web: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
verses.en_bbe: Let your ear be open to suggestion and take teaching, so that at the end you may be wise.

verses.en: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
verses.pt: Muitos são os planos no coração do homem; mas o desígnio do Senhor, esse prevalecerá.
verses.en_web: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
verses.en_bbe: A man's heart may be full of designs, but the purpose of the Lord is unchanging.

verses.en: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.pt: O que faz um homem desejável é a sua benignidade; e o pobre é melhor do que o mentiroso.
verses.en_web: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
verses.en_bbe: The ornament of a man is his mercy, and a poor man is better than one who is false.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
verses.pt: O temor do Senhor encaminha para a vida; aquele que o tem ficará satisfeito, e mal nenhum o visitará.
verses.en_web: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
verses.en_bbe: The fear of the Lord gives life: and he who has it will have need of nothing; no evil will come his way.

verses.en: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.pt: O preguiçoso esconde a sua mão no prato, e nem ao menos quer levá-la de novo à boca.
verses.en_web: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.en_bbe: The hater of work puts his hand deep into the basin, and will not even take it to his mouth again.

verses.en: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
verses.pt: Fere ao escarnecedor, e o simples aprenderá a prudência; repreende ao que tem entendimento, e ele crescerá na ciencia.
verses.en_web: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: When blows overtake the man of pride, the simple will get sense; say sharp words to the wise, and knowledge will be made clear to him.

verses.en: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
verses.pt: O que aflige a seu pai, e faz fugir a sua mãe, é filho que envergonha e desonra.
verses.en_web: He who robs his father and drives away his mother, is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
verses.en_bbe: He who is violent to his father, driving away his mother, is a son causing shame and a bad name.

verses.en: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.pt: Cessa, filho meu, de ouvir a instrução, e logo te desviarás das palavras do conhecimento.
verses.en_web: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: A son who no longer gives attention to teaching is turned away from the words of knowledge.

verses.en: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
verses.pt: A testemunha vil escarnece da justiça; e a boca dos ímpios engole a iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: A good-for-nothing witness makes sport of the judge's decision: and the mouth of evil-doers sends out evil like a stream.

verses.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
verses.pt: A condenação está preparada para os escarnecedores, e os açoites para as costas dos tolos.
verses.en_web: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
verses.en_bbe: Rods are being made ready for the man of pride, and blows for the back of the foolish.
